entries.name: /analyzecode
entries.purpose: Run the wxICA architecture review on the current codebase — mechanical drift audit followed by judgment-driven deepening candidates.
entries.usage:
/analyzecode                       # full review: drift audit + deepening exploration
/analyzecode --drift-only          # mechanical drift audit only — stop after step 0
/analyzecode --deepen-only         # skip drift audit, go straight to deepening
/analyzecode --scope <path>        # restrict exploration to a subtree (e.g. <path>)
/analyzecode --since <git-ref>     # tailor the drift audit's "recent diff" to a ref (default: last commit)
/analyzecode --collect-only [--out <file>]  # unattended: steps 0-2 only; writes a findings file (default docs/brainstorms/analyze/findings/analyzecode.json); no questions, no edits

Asks once about an optional read-only database check (default no; names and counts only)
/wxBrainstorm --analyze --conversion                      # same, and adds wxConversionParity for a conversion
/wxBrainstorm --analyze --cross-app --dir <app>,<app>     # run in wxKanban only: reads each app's saved data file, never writes into them; a gap in 2+ apps becomes one converter scope proposal
